headline: Graph and foundation models integrate multi-omics and knowledge graphs for prediction
label: Graph Learning For Multi Omics
summary: Knowledge graphs, single-cell foundation models and multi-omics learners now predict drug indications, perturbations and microbiome states.
synthesis: The dominant thread is learned representations that fuse heterogeneous biological graphs or multi-omics profiles with task-specific predictive heads. Several items operate on knowledge graphs: CellAwareGNN adds OneK1K cell-type-specific expression to PrimeKG-U for drug indication prediction, LinkDTI casts drug-target prediction as link prediction over a drug-protein-disease-side-effect graph, and MAP conditions a single-cell foundation model on a 187k-drug knowledge graph for zero-shot perturbation prediction. Others apply graph or attention architectures directly to omics or microbiome data, including FaGGCN for cancer multi-omics subtyping, DVMMHGNN for microbe-informed drug repurposing, and HMOTP for small-sample longitudinal fecal microbiota transplantation trajectories. The more distinctive elements are the coupling of pretrained single-cell foundation models with knowledge-graph priors in MAP, and the uncertainty-aware synthetic lethality framework using conformal prediction.
